description: A Maven project named 'data-processor' has been loaded in IntelliJ IDEA at ~/IdeaProjects/data-processor/. The project compiles and its tests pass, but the pom.xml has three dependency management problems that violate Maven best practices and cause issues in a production build. Use IntelliJ's Maven tool window and the pom.xml editor to identify and fix all three issues: (1) One dependency that belongs only in the test classpath is incorrectly declared with 'compile' scope — it should have 'test' scope. (2) The same library appears twice in the dependencies section with two different version numbers — remove the duplicate so only one version remains (keep the higher version). (3) One dependency is declared in pom.xml but is never imported or used anywhere in the production source code — remove it entirely. After making all three fixes, reload the Maven project in IntelliJ and verify the project still compiles and all tests pass.
